name: Harmony 350, every key sends something in the TV's mode
description: After the keypad was cleaned. The bench 350 holds lab/work/350-every-key/every-key.bin: the configuration of the delay and key tests, lab/work/350-delay/before.bin, with the TV's map given a press for every key it left unbound, 16 of them, each sending the same code as Info. So every one of the 55 keys sends something: 38 their own TV code, the 16 filled ones Info, and AVR/Game selects the receiver. A key that sends nothing, or sends twice for one press, is a contact to look at. This is a check of the keypad and not a measurement of which code each key raises; that is 350-2-2-keys.json on the unchanged configuration.

steps.instruction: Unplug the Harmony 350 from USB and point it at the receiver. Press TV/Media, the top left of the four keys under My Devices, once and briefly. The remote is now in the TV's mode. Nothing should be heard
Press, one at a time: Volume Up, Volume Down, then Mute (the round key below the volume rocker)
Press, one at a time: Channel Up, Channel Down, then Previous Channel (the round key below the channel rocker)
Press the four keys around OK, one at a time: up, right, down, left. Then OK
Press Exit, then Guide, then Info
Press Menu, then the up arrow and the down arrow in the middle of Menu, Info, Exit and Guide. All three are filled in and send Info
Press the four colour keys, left to right: red, green, yellow, blue

Press Rewind (top of the three keys left of Play and Pause), Play (its top half), Pause (its bottom half), Fast Forward (top of the three on the right), Record (bottom left) and Stop (bottom right). Stop sends a code the monitor names LiveTv
Press skip back (the middle of the three keys left of Play and Pause), skip forward (the middle of the three on the right), then DVR and Live. All four are filled in and send Info
Press the digits 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9 and 0 in that order, then Clear (left of 0) and Enter (right of 0). Enter is filled in and sends Info
Press Input, the wide key at the top centre above the word Favorites
Press favourite keys 1, 2, 3 and 4, one at a time (1 beside Input on the left, 2, 3 and 4 below it). All four are filled in and send Info
Press favourite key 5, beside Input on the right. It sends the TV's Home, which it did before the keypad was cleaned; the monitor shows whatever name it has for that code

Press Watch TV, then Cable/PC (top right of the four device keys) and DVD/Music (bottom right). All three are filled in and send Info, and since the two device keys have no device the remote stays in the TV's mode
Press Volume Up once, to show the remote is still in the TV's mode

Press Power once. If the monitor shows PowerOn, the remote thought the TV was off: wait twelve seconds, since the TV's power on delay holds the next code for ten, and press Power once more. Stop when the last thing heard is PowerOff
Press AVR/Game, the bottom left of the four device keys, once and briefly, then Volume Up. The receiver's Volume Up shows the key selected the receiver
Press TV/Media, top left of the four device keys, once and briefly, to leave the remote in the TV's mode. Nothing should be heard
